about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing cowboys overcharge my neighbours.
about_para_1: Kal's Heating & Plumbing has been serving Slough and the surrounding area for over 18 years. We started small — one van, one engineer — and built our reputation on showing up on time, fixing the problem right, and charging a fair price. Today we've completed over 2,400 jobs, from midnight emergency callouts to full central heating overhauls.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, explain what we're doing, and never leave a mess. We're Gas Safe registered, we carry parts on every van, and we guarantee our work. Slough knows us — we fix neighbour's pipes, their boilers, their heating systems — and they trust us enough to recommend us to their mates.
reviews_heading: What Slough Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator before Christmas. Kal came out the same evening and had it sorted in 45 minutes. Brilliant bloke, fair price. Will definitely use again.

reviews.text: Called them at midnight with a burst pipe. They were here in 55 minutes, fixed it, and didn't even charge extra for the time. Saved us from a flooded kitchen. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Jenny P.

reviews.text: New boiler installation last month. Kal's crew were tidy, professional, and explained everything as they went. The CP12 was ready the same day. Really impressed. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David K.
